name: my-source
description: What this brings in, in one sentence, read from the app's own files on this Mac. Read-only: the store is opened for reading and nothing is ever written to it. macOS only.

connect.note: Say what this copies into Clockwork, and which permission macOS will ask for. Reading another app's files usually needs Full Disk Access for the program that runs Clockwork (System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access). That is a broad permission and only the user can grant it.
